name: Genius Decision
description: Create, review, evaluate, and export versioned decision models with reproducible engine receipts.
notes: The hosted service accepts synthetic or non-personal data only. Results are conditional on declared model assumptions and do not establish empirical validity. OAuth is not available.
installHint: Read the live manifest and data policy linked from the setup guide, then register an isolated agent at POST /api/agents/register with explicit scopes. Default scopes do not include the twin model tools: request twins:read, twins:write, and twins:evaluate for those operations. Request twins:delete or account:delete only when cleanup is intended. Evaluation consumes the service's shared quota; inspect errors before retrying.

auth.credentialHelp: Obtain a scoped machine token using the [agent setup guide](https://geniusdecision.app/agents). Paste only the token; the client sends it in the Authorization: Bearer header. This credential accesses its own agent space, not a human account.
